title: WhimMobs
description: A Resource pack that edits certain mobs into WhimSMP members!
body:
This is a pack designed for players of the WhimSMP, changing some mobs (Check Below for full list) to be different members of the server.
# Current Mobs include:
- Axolotl - **Mainstage**
  ![an axolotl with the design of MainstageSCV](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cfd278978dd48c05b8a2ed73e1b4c50d543360e.png)
- Diamond Horse Armor - **Pants**
  ![a horse wearing diamond horse armor, designed to look like PantsTheGod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fca332f13ce6853ce47cb553770a7d851604b0c.png)
- Golden Horse Armor - **Raaf**
  ![a horse wearing golden horse armor, designed to look like DrFreakhead](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be86f1e63bf9554fc44915f69f070afe5420491b.png)
- Iron Horse Armor - **WrittenCross**
  ![a horse wearing iron horse armor, designed to look like WrittenCross](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41210903bffd8f54a420f98ca5d0f59058a508b2.png)
- Donkey - **Krem**
  ![a donkey wearing chests with the Thai Flag, the donkey is wearing a suit to look like KyrisKrem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df0599f4b99b9d89e8722fd0cfcf3e43ddca67ad.png)
- Cat - **Willow**
  ![a cat (white variant) designed to look like WillowsCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c344b464d0989ee87a0f39e2702beb52be75a23f.png)
- Frog - **Baz**
![a frog (Cold variant) designed to look like ChaosBaz](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c828e9e080d19009464eea820db627f6b5fb0d93.png)
### With more to come...
